name: Code Block
description: Minimal syntax-highlighted code block with line numbers, copy action, and accent color customization.
summary: A borderless syntax-highlighted code block. Line numbers and tokens stay aligned across empty lines, and long lines scroll horizontally. Includes one-click clipboard copy and an accent color for highlighted tokens.
highlights: Borderless, container-free aesthetic designed to float cleanly on dark backgrounds
Per-row line synchronization ensuring line numbers never desync from code lines
Accent color applied to keywords, JSX tags, numbers and strings
One-click clipboard copy button with active feedback states
anatomy: <CodeBlock> (Root container with font-mono and select-text styling)
<div> (Line row pairing the line number with its tokens)

recommended: Inline documentation snippets and interactive code playgrounds
Developer tool displays and command showcases
Clean terminal or code output screens without visual clutter
bestPractices: Pass a valid CSS color string to color to match your product's accent theme
Use showLineNumbers={false} for compact single-line or small multi-line snippets

props.name: code
props.description: Code string to display and syntax highlight.

props.name: language
props.description: Language hint for the snippet. The built-in tokenizer highlights every language the same way.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent color for keywords, numbers, tags, and highlights.

props.name: showLineNumbers
props.description: Whether to display line numbers column on the left.

props.name: filename
props.description: Optional filename or title displayed above the code.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to customize spacing or container.
